## Integrity checklist

- [ ] No target-domain information was used for training, calibration, or selection.
- [ ] No experiment result is claimed without a registry entry and artifact reference.
- [ ] New behavior has tests or a documented reason why a test is impossible.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration match the implementation.
- [ ] Large data, credentials, checkpoints, and machine-specific paths are not committed.
